newsitem.title: JAPAN: Excessive yen depreciation vs dlr undesirable - MOF.
newsitem.headline: Excessive yen depreciation vs dlr undesirable - MOF.

text.p: Excessive depreciation of the yen against the dollar is undesirable, Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told reporters on Thursday.
Asked about the dollar's rise against the yen to the mid-117 yen level overnight, Mitsuzuka said: "It's not desirable for the foreign exchange rate to fluctuate (wildly)."

Asked whether Japan maintained a stance that it would continue to deal appropriately with excessive depreciation of the yen, Mitsuzuka said: "Yes, excessiveness (in the yen's depreciation) is undesirable."
